messages:
maria: Observed customer report: streaming request that invoked a tool ended up with both a provisional and a confirmed charge after a reconnect. trace id: tx-7b1

alan: quick q - provisional + confirmed or duplicated confirmed?

maria: provisional written at router accept (estimate 110 tokens). route swapped mid-stream to low-cost region, router rewrite dropped client idempotency header, runtime retried toolcall -> confirmed 88 tokens. billing added confirmed without removing provisional.

dev: so two problems: header loss during swap + billing not reconciling provisional entries.

billing-bot: current behavior: provisional entries are applied immediately. dedupe is based on runtime_request_id only.

alan: proposal: router generates a session_commit_id on ingress, attach X-Session-Commit to downstream. billing should use that to reconcile provisional->confirmed. runtime accepts header if present.

maria: agree. console UX: show provisional as "pending" not final charge; tooltip TTL and link to support. ops alert if pending->final delta > 10% over 5m.
dev: short mitigation: revert canary rule that rewrites headers. add runtime guard to reject toolcall replay without idempotency header (fail-fast).

alan: owners: router#129 preserve-headers (dev), billing#430 pending-ledger (maria), console#178 pending-ui (alan).

maria: I'll draft billing doc. thanks.
